title: 第二百一十四章 大壮你受伤了第二百一十三章 人人敬仰的医生
content_zh:
第二百一十四章大壮，你受伤了？
王老师听完后沉默了。
他重新把王大壮刚才那些话在脑子里过了一遍，然后抬头看着王大壮，目光跟之前不太一样了。
那是一种看一个同行的目光，一个在自己的领域里真正有事做的人才会被赋予的目光。
“王医生，那你觉得，这种罕见病毒有什么办法来对付？”
王大壮把这个想法告诉了王老师，对方听完之后没有说话，沉默了好一会儿才开口道：“大壮，你说的这个赤阳草，你见过吗？”
王大壮摇了摇头道：“没见过实物，但古书上记载了它的样子和生长环境。只要它存在，我就能找到它。”
王老师看着王大壮，此刻觉得这个年轻人不简单，不急躁不鲁莽更不怂。
其他学生见到患者病情和身上的病状后，全都吓得不行，反而王大壮却能够冷静地分析出病因，寻找病原，还能对症下药。
尽管目前这个特效药还没找到。
此时对王大壮也是极为重视道：“好。你需要什么，跟我说，我尽力给你安排。”
王大壮把目光投向帐篷外面那片灰蒙蒙的天空，仿佛瘟疫在蔓延。
“王老师，我还需要一些人手，跟我一起去找赤阳草。越快越好，越多人越好。”王大壮对王老师解释道。
“这个……”王老师瞬间为自己刚才说的话感到不好意思，“大壮，是这样的，现在村里医生人手不够，所以寻找赤阳草可能没办法找人帮忙，估计需要你自己一个人去找……”
王大壮也不知道王老师的为难，于是没有再勉强道：“王老师，既然如此，那我就自己去找！”
“大壮，辛苦你了，要是找不到就算了。”王老师却是不忍心打击道。
“王老师，具体有没有，只有等找了才知道。”王大壮却淡淡一笑道：“不过，只要有万分之一的机会，我都不会放弃！”
王老师瞬间感觉愧疚，拍了拍他的肩膀道：“行，那你就放手去找吧，村里有其他医生照料，应该不成问题！”
于是，第二天天还没亮透，王大壮就背着背篓出了门。
临走前他在孙菲菲床头的桌板上留了一张字条：“我去山里找赤阳草，你在村里等我，别到处跑。”

可他刚走出村口不到二里地，身后就传来了踩在碎石上的脚步声。
他回头一看，孙菲菲穿着一件深色的外套，背着一个布袋，正快步朝他走来。
“你怎么来了？”
“你一个人进山我不放心。”孙菲菲走到他身边停下脚步，眼神温柔道：“你跟我说过，赤阳草长在南面悬崖上，你一个人去太危险了。”
王大壮看了她一眼，没有再赶她回去，反而微微一笑道：“行，一起走。不过要是走不动了就跟我说。”
“好！”
两个人沿着后山的羊肠小道往上走，路越走越窄，越走越陡。
content_en:
Chapter 214 Da Zhuang, are you injured?
Teacher Wang was silent after listening.
He went over what Wang Dazhuang had just said in his mind again, and then looked up at Wang Dazhuang, his eyes were different from before.
It is a look that is given to a peer, a look that can only be given to someone who has really done something in his or her field.
"Dr. Wang, what do you think can be done to deal with this rare virus?"
Wang Dazhuang told Teacher Wang this idea. The other person did not speak after listening. He was silent for a while before he said, "Dazhuang, have you seen this red sun grass you mentioned?"
Wang Dazhuang shook his head and said: "I have never seen the real thing, but its appearance and growth environment are recorded in ancient books. As long as it exists, I can find it."
Teacher Wang looked at Wang Dazhuang and felt that this young man was not simple, neither impatient nor reckless nor timid.
When other students saw the patient's condition and symptoms, they were all frightened. On the contrary, Wang Dazhuang was able to calmly analyze the cause of the disease, find the pathogen, and prescribe the right medicine.
Although this specific medicine has not yet been found.
At this time, he also paid great attention to Wang Dazhuang and said: "Okay. If you need anything, tell me and I will try my best to arrange it for you."
Wang Dazhuang cast his gaze toward the gray sky outside the tent, as if a plague was spreading.
"Teacher Wang, I still need some manpower to find Red Sun Grass with me. The faster, the better, and the more people, the better." Wang Dazhuang explained to Teacher Wang.
"Well..." Teacher Wang felt embarrassed for what he had just said. "Dazhuang, that's it. There are not enough doctors in the village now, so you may not be able to find anyone to help you find red sun grass. You probably need to find it by yourself..."
Wang Dazhuang didn't know what Teacher Wang was in trouble, so he didn't force himself and said: "Teacher Wang, if that's the case, then I'll go find it myself!"
"Dazhuang, thank you for your hard work. If I can't find it, forget it." Teacher Wang couldn't bear to attack.
"Teacher Wang, we won't know until we find it." Wang Dazhuang smiled lightly and said, "However, as long as there is a one in ten thousand chance, I will not give up!"
Teacher Wang felt guilty for a moment, patted him on the shoulder and said, "Okay, then go ahead and look for him. There are other doctors in the village taking care of him, so it shouldn't be a problem!"
So, before it was bright the next day, Wang Dazhuang went out with a basket on his back.
Before leaving, he left a note on the table beside Sun Feifei's bed: "I will go to the mountains to find red sun grass. You wait for me in the village and don't run around."
But as soon as he walked less than two miles from the village entrance, he heard the sound of footsteps stepping on gravel behind him.
He looked back and saw that Sun Feifei was walking towards him quickly, wearing a dark coat and carrying a cloth bag.
"Why are you here?"
"I'm worried about you going into the mountain alone." Sun Feifei walked to him and stopped, her eyes gentle and said: "You told me that red sun grass grows on the southern cliff, and it is too dangerous for you to go alone."
Wang Dazhuang glanced at her and did not chase her back. Instead, he smiled slightly and said, "Okay, let's go together. But if you can't walk anymore, just tell me."
"Okay!"
The two people walked up the winding path in the back mountain. The road became narrower and steeper as they went.
